content.text: Added `winapi = "=0.3.9"` for the Windows API bindings, plus `winapi-i686-pc-windows-gnu = "=0.4.0"` under a `[target.i686-pc-windows-gnu.dependencies]` section — this is the GNU-toolchain-specific import library crate that supplies the `.a` stub libraries the MinGW linker needs (MSVC gets these from the Windows SDK automatically; GNU doesn't). Both are pinned exactly, matching the existing `serde` style, using the latest versions currently on crates.io.
